title: feat(lint): data-model advisories carry a localized user sentence
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Fixes #32838

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据模型类的保存提示（advisory）现在也有给最终用户看的一句话，11 种平台语言都有：自动编号格式 2 条、外部对象列表视图的排序与搜索各 1 条、数据集基于“像平台对象但没人提供”的对象 1 条，共 5 条规则 id；规则 id、`message`、`hint` 一字不变。
- 为什么改：按 #32835 / #32655 已落地的做法（裁决 6819749037 选 C），中文 Studio 里保存对象、列表视图、数据集时看到的仍是英文提醒；现在由出提醒的规则自己按用户语言出文案。卡片表里 10 条中有 5 条保存时根本不会返回（只在命令行跑，或属于 `os lint` 的最佳实践检查），它们没有用户文案，原因写在验收说明里。
- 风险与回滚：只新增文案和发现对象上的一个可选字段，外加自动编号规则的注册适配器把这个字段透传出来；保存接口现在还不填 `userMessage`（那是 #32656），所以所有返回内容不变。`@objectstack/lint` 按 patch 发版。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/lint-autonumber-formats.user-text.ts`（两条自动编号提示、两种写法的各语言文案）、`packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.ts`（只在数据集基础对象这一处带参数）、`packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.data-model.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.data-model.test.ts`，应见 20 个测试全绿，其中三条是从发布门（对象写入、视图写入、数据集写入）拿到的提示渲染成能被 `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` 解析的 `userMessage`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Layer 1 of #32654 for the data-model advisories, in the pattern #32655 landed (`validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`, `finding-user-text.test.ts`), under ruling record 6819749037 (option C).

**Re-measured first.** The card's table (10 ids in 6 files, a static-scan upper bound) was checked by running each warning push site of the six files through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` on `origin/main` `5c005e0e`, with `object`, `view` (flattened overlay and container), `dataset`, `page` and `flow` writes:

| Rule file | Door-reaching advisory ids (write) | Not reaching the door |
|---|---|---|
| `lint-autonumber-formats.ts` | `autonumber-unrecognized-token`, `autonumber-references-optional-field` (object) | — |
| `validate-sortable-fields.ts` | `sort-field-unprovisioned` (object, view) | `page-field-unprovisioned` reaches it on a page write, but is `validate-page-field-bindings.ts`'s id (#32840) |
| `validate-searchable-fields.ts` | `searchable-field-unprovisioned` (object, view) | — |
| `validate-object-references.ts` | `object-reference-unregistered-platform` (dataset, the base-object site) | the field, view, action, dashboard-filter and navigation sites |
| `data-model-rules.ts` | — | `unique/double-declaration`, `unique/legacy-organization-composite`, `field/select-missing-options`, `relationship/master-detail-required`, `relationship/association-inline-edit` |
| `validate-record-title.ts` | — | `title-unresolvable` |

The seat agreed to cover the five and name the rest (surface amendment on the card). See Acceptance notes for each reason.

**`packages/lint`.**

- Four catalogs, new, beside their rules, each in all 11 `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS` and in the console's terms from `ui/packages/i18n` (object, field, Auto Number, record number, required, list view, external object, sort, searchable fields, dataset, remote table):
  - `lint-autonumber-formats.user-text.ts`: the two autonumber ids. `autonumber-unrecognized-token` has one arm per `kind` (`unknown-token`, `second-counter`), as the rule's message does.
  - `validate-sortable-fields.user-text.ts`: `sort-field-unprovisioned`, addressed to the list view.
  - `validate-searchable-fields.user-text.ts`: `searchable-field-unprovisioned`, one arm per `role` (`canonical`, the object's own searchable fields; `narrowing`, a list's search fields), as the rule's message does.
  - `validate-object-references.user-text.ts`: `object-reference-unregistered-platform`, addressed to the dataset.
- Push sites: `lint-autonumber-formats.ts` sets `userTextParams` at both warning sites; `checkSortDeclaration` and `checkSearchableFieldList` set it at their unprovisioned-anchor sites (so every caller of those cores carries it); `validate-object-references.ts` sets it at the dataset base-object site only, through an optional `check` argument. Each finding interface gains `userTextParams?`. Rule ids, `message` and `hint` are unchanged.
- `authoring-rules.ts`: the `lintAutonumberFormats` registry adapter re-maps each field and dropped `userTextParams`; it now spreads it when present (one line, the same as #32836's `lintFlowCredentialLiterals` line). No other entry changes.
- `finding-user-text.ts`: `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` merges the four catalogs via `mergeUserTextCatalogs`.
- No new export: the catalogs stay internal, as `SECURITY_POSTURE_USER_TEXT` is.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/32838-advisory-user-text.md`, `@objectstack/lint` `patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. Precedent followed: #32837 (PR #33118), the sibling sub-card, declared `none` and `patch` for the same lint-only change, reading #32790 (the #32655 PR): its `added` came only from the `@objectstack/spec` key `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema.userMessage`, and it shipped the lint half as `patch`. This PR moves no spec key and no accepted value.

**Not in this PR.** The save door composing `userMessage` (#32656) and the console rendering it (#32657). Until #32656 lands, every save and publish response is byte-identical.

## Tests

Counts from the tree at `f4ce7b50` (branch point `main` `5c005e0e`). The head `4605d6ef` merges `main` `5b2ec820` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (one incoming commit, #33122 in `packages/spec` `stack.zod.ts`; none touches `packages/lint`; no conflict; no generated artifact left to regenerate). After the merge: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated` (all 14 artifacts up to date), and the three user-text pin files, 72 passed (72), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.data-model.test.ts` (new, 20 tests):
  - exact coverage: each of the four catalogs holds exactly its door-reaching ids, each in exactly the 11 platform locales; all are the entries `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` serves; the five ids are pinned by value;
  - the six ids the door never returns have no catalog entry;
  - every push site rendered from the rule's real findings (7 cases: both autonumber token arms, the optional-field site, the list-view sort site, both search roles, the dataset site): severity `warning`, the exact params, every locale truthy, no `undefined` or template residue, every interpolated name present, and no English stand-in in any non-English locale;
  - the two token arms and the two search roles render apart in every locale;
  - zh-Hans and en spot checks on the Auto Number sentence;
  - no params where the finding is not door advice: an autonumber error, the page-sort `page-field-unprovisioned` warning, and an object field's lookup site of the object-reference rule;
  - from the runtime gate to the wire field: an `object` write's autonumber advisory (through the registry adapter), a `view` write's sort and search advisories, and a `dataset` write's object-reference advisory come out of `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` with their params, and the rendered `userMessage` (zh-CN, fr-FR, ja-JP requests) parses under `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` beside the unchanged rule id and message.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 204 passed (204), Tests 8654 passed, 5 skipped (8659), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`), then `build`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Consumer reading (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, which runs the gate on every save; closure built with `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/metadata-protocol^...' build`): Test Files 337 passed, 7 skipped (344); Tests 22799 passed, 36 skipped (22835); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

<details><summary>Ablations (committed first at f4ce7b50, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

| # | Mutation | Observed |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `authoring-rules.ts`: drop the `userTextParams` spread in the `lintAutonumberFormats` adapter | 1 failed, 19 passed (the object-write gate case) |
| 2 | `validate-object-references.ts`: drop `{ dataset: dsName }` at the dataset site | 2 failed, 18 passed (the dataset render case and the dataset-write gate case) |
| 3 | `validate-searchable-fields.ts`: drop `userTextParams` at the unprovisioned site | 4 failed, 16 passed (both role cases, the arms case, the view-write gate case) |

Each mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed) and each restore read `blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD is empty`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Five card ids stay on the English fallback, by measurement.** `unique/double-declaration` and `unique/legacy-organization-composite` are registered `CLI_ONLY` with `RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADVISORY_VOLUME`, and so is `title-unresolvable` (`validateRecordTitle`). `field/select-missing-options`, `relationship/master-detail-required` and `relationship/association-inline-edit` are emitted only by `lintDataModel`, the `os lint` best-practice sweep, which has no registry entry: no write reaches them. A sentence the door can never render would be declared but not delivered. Parent #32835 allows naming such ids with the reason they stay on the English fallback.
- **`page-field-unprovisioned` is left to #32840.** `validate-sortable-fields.ts` pushes it at its page-sort site (a page write returns it), but its constant, its other push site and so its catalog belong to `validate-page-field-bindings.ts`, which is #32840's table; a rule id has one catalog owner. #32840's catalog must also set `userTextParams` at the page-sort site in `validate-sortable-fields.ts` (`checkPageSortDeclaration`); a pin here asserts that site carries none today.
- **Object-reference sites other than the dataset carry no params.** The rule runs at the door on `flow` and `dataset` writes; only a dataset's base object is on the written item. A flow write's objects, views, actions, dashboards and apps are context on both sides of the differential, so those findings cancel (measured: a flow write over context with a `sys_`-prefixed lookup target returns none, and an object write does not dispatch the member).
- **Agent-written non-English sentences, for the native-review round.** All non-English sentences in the four new catalogs are agent-written: 10 locales (`zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko`) × 5 entries, 7 sentences per locale counting arms (`autonumber-unrecognized-token` ×2, `autonumber-references-optional-field`, `sort-field-unprovisioned`, `searchable-field-unprovisioned` ×2, `object-reference-unregistered-platform`). Points worth a native reader's eye: the console has no translated "Auto Number" label outside en and zh (`engine.fieldType.autonumber`), so the other locales use a plain term ("numeración automática", "Autonummernfeld", "自動採番", "자동 번호", …); `de` uses the console's "Datensatz" for both dataset and record, which is why the dataset sentence speaks only of data ("keine Daten") and the Auto Number sentences say "Datensatznummer"; Korean particles are written in the dual form (`을(를)`, `이(가)`) because the name is interpolated; the external-object clause reuses the wording of the landed `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` sentences.
- **API names, not labels**, as the security catalog does (its N3, accepted): the rule is a pure function of the stack with no label lookup in the request's language.
- **New test file, not `finding-user-text.test.ts`.** The pins sit in `finding-user-text.data-model.test.ts`, as #32837's sit in `finding-user-text.dashboards.test.ts`, so parallel sibling cards do not collide; the shape is the same.
- #32836 (PR #33120, open) also adds lines to `finding-user-text.ts`; whichever lands second merges `main` and keeps every catalog line. #33072 edits `validate-expressions.ts`; this PR does not touch it.
- Ruling grep over the surface (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): hits in `validate-object-references.ts` (9, resolution-ladder and ADR-0130 notes), `validate-sortable-fields.ts` (3, type-list notes), `validate-searchable-fields.ts` (1), `finding-user-text.ts` (2, ruling record 6819749037 and the one-locale-list rule), `authoring-rules.ts` (63, registry entries); none constrains a user sentence or the adapter line.
